parameters.content:
## Purchase Requisition Approval & Budget Control

### How it works

This workflow receives a purchase requisition from a form, normalizes the request data, and validates that the request is complete. It checks the relevant cost center and available budget in Google Sheets, then routes valid and funded requests through the required approval path. Depending on the outcome, it updates budget records, logs the requisition status, and emails the employee with an approval or rejection notification.

### Setup steps

- Configure the form trigger with all required requisition fields, such as employee details, department, cost center, item details, amount, and justification.
- Connect Google Sheets credentials and map the budget and requisition log sheets used for cost center lookup, budget updates, and status logging.
- Connect Gmail credentials for approval requests and employee notifications.
- Review the wait/approval mechanism so approvers can return a decision in the format expected by the “Request Approved?” node.
- Set the approval thresholds, currency, approver recipients, sheet column names, and email templates to match your organization’s process.

### Customization

Adjust approval thresholds, rejection reasons, email wording, Google Sheets ranges, and routing rules for different departments, currencies, or approval hierarchies.

## Capture requisition request

Starts the workflow from the purchase requisition form and applies base configuration values such as currency and approval thresholds.

## Normalize and validate data

Standardizes key requisition fields and branches based on whether the submitted data is valid and complete.

## Check cost center status

Looks up the cost center budget record in Google Sheets and verifies that the cost center is active before continuing.

## Validate budget availability

Prepares the budget context and checks whether the requested amount can be covered by the available cost center budget.

## Request approval decision

Determines the required approval level, emails the approval request, waits for a decision, and branches based on whether the requisition was approved.

## Finalize approved requisition

Prepares the approved requisition record, updates the cost center budget, logs the approval, and sends confirmation to the employee.

## Handle approver rejection

Handles requisitions rejected during the approval decision step by preparing the rejected record, logging it, and notifying the employee.

## Handle budget rejection

Processes the insufficient-budget branch by setting the rejection status, logging the rejection, and emailing the employee.

## Handle inactive cost center

Processes requests tied to inactive cost centers by preparing the rejection, recording it in Google Sheets, and sending a notification.

## Handle invalid requisition

Processes invalid submissions by creating the rejection status, logging the failed requisition, and notifying the employee.

Your purchase requisition has been approved.

Requisition ID: {{ $('Set Approved Requisition Details').item.json.requisitionId }}
Department: {{ $('Set Approved Requisition Details').item.json.department }}
Item / Service: {{ $('Set Approved Requisition Details').item.json.itemDescription }}

Approved Amount: PKR {{ $('Set Approved Requisition Details').item.json.approvedAmount }}
Approval Level: {{ $('Set Approved Requisition Details').item.json.approvalLevel }}

Your requisition has successfully completed the approval and budget validation process.

Regards,
Purchase Requisition Workflow

Dear {{ $('Build Insufficient Budget Rejection').item.json.employeeName }},

Requisition ID: {{ $('Build Insufficient Budget Rejection').item.json.requisitionId }}
Department: {{ $('Build Insufficient Budget Rejection').item.json.department }}
Item / Service: {{ $('Build Insufficient Budget Rejection').item.json.itemDescription }}
Estimated Total Cost: PKR {{ $('Build Insufficient Budget Rejection').item.json.estimatedTotalCost }}
Available Budget: PKR {{ $('Build Insufficient Budget Rejection').item.json.availableBudget }}
Cost Center: {{ $('Build Insufficient Budget Rejection').item.json.costCenter }}
Status: Rejected
Reason: Insufficient budget

Please review the requested amount or contact the relevant budget owner before submitting a new requisition.

Regards,
Purchase Requisition Workflow
